frontmatter.sidebar_description: Reindex one or more search indexes.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `reindexSearchIndexesWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.
This workflow rebuilds one or more search indexes from their seed.

steps.name: validateSearchIndexesExistStep
steps.description:
This step validates that each requested search index is registered. If an
index is missing, the step throws an error.

steps.name: reindexSearchIndexesStep
steps.description: This step rebuilds one or more search indexes from their seed.

steps.name: searchIndexesReindexed
steps.description:
This hook is called after the indexes have been
reindexed. You can use it to perform any custom actions.

children.name: index
children.description: The name of the index to reindex. Defaults to every registered index.

children.name: strategy
children.description:
How to rebuild. `swap` fills a shadow index and aliases over; `in_place`
writes into the live index.

blocks.html:
Hooks allow you to inject custom functionalities into the workflow. You'll receive data from the workflow, as well as additional data sent through an HTTP request.

Learn more about [Hooks](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/workflow-hooks) and [Additional Data](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/api-routes/additional-data).

This hook is called after the indexes have been
reindexed. You can use it to perform any custom actions.
Handlers consuming this hook accept the following input.

types.name: input
types.description: The input data for the hook.
